name: Geekbench: Photo Filter
description: Applies colour and blur filters, level adjustments, cropping, scaling, and image compositing filters to 10 photos that range in size from 3 MP to 15 MP.The score is calibrated against a baseline score of 2,500 (Dell Precision 3460 with a Core i7-12700 processor) as per the Geekbench 6 Benchmark Internals.
note: This benchmark does not scale well on instances with more than 32 vCPUs. Empirical data shows measured scores plateau and may even degrade as vCPU count increases, so it is not recommended for evaluating larger instance sizes.
